notes.title: Update ver1.0.3
notes.content: [p]The following updates have been made to ver1.0.3.[/p][p][/p][h2]Gamepad (Xbox) Support[/h2][p]This update supports gamepad (Xbox) operation![/p][p]The game also supports real-time device changes. If you have both a keyboard & mouse and a gamepad, you can switch devices at any time you like![/p][p][/p][h2]Improved comfort[/h2][list][*][p]Until now, the puzzle on the induction table (puzzle table) was automatically solved the moment you stored more than the required value on the induction table, but a new "trade button" has been introduced to prevent it from being solved automatically.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]In the battle tutorial, you can no longer swing your sword unless you take the required steps.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]In order to make it clear at a glance whether you are concentrating, we have improved it so that the "Mist Stance" motion is inserted when you are concentrating.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug fixes, etc.[/h2][list][*][p]Hotfix for the issue where the induction table would not be released even if you stored the same amount of value as the required value of the induction table.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Other minor fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update ver1.0.2
notes.content:
The following corrections and adjustments have been made.
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where concentration analysis was not performed correctly when concentrating on another fallen warrior after successfully dispelling evil spirits or performing an Iaido-slash.
[*] Changed the required value of some guidance platforms.
[*] Adjusted the volume of Hannya's voice.
[*] Overall adjustment of initial volume.
[*] Lowered the lower limit of each volume adjustment bar.
[/list]

The development team has also confirmed the following issues. We will address them as soon as we find the cause.
[list]
[*] Problem where the guidance platform is not released even if the same amount of value as the required value of the guidance platform is paid.
[*] Problem where item respawning does not work properly under certain conditions.
[/list]

notes.title: Update ver1.0.1
notes.content:

[/list]
